en: A black-and-white postcard showing the entrance to an old building complex with an archway and stone walls. Two soldiers are standing at the entrance, and a sign reads 'U.S. ARMY Camp Hospital No. 52.' The background shows a church-like structure with pointed roofs and arched windows. The caption at the bottom provides historical context about the building's use during and after World War I.
